## Description

Describe the problem clearly and explain how it affects your application or users.

## Steps to Reproduce

Provide the smallest complete example that consistently reproduces the issue. Include the
commands, inputs, or request sequence needed to observe it.

## Expected Behavior

Describe what you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior

Describe what happened instead. Include the complete error message or traceback when available.

## Environment

- Flask-RPBAC version:
- Python version:
- Flask version:
- Installation method (`pip`, source checkout, or other):

## Relevant Code or Configuration

Include only the minimal code or configuration needed to understand the issue. Remove passwords,
tokens, personal data, and other sensitive information.

## Additional Context

Add relevant logs, screenshots, links, or other information that may help diagnose the issue.
Do not include confidential or sensitive information.

## Checklist

- I have searched existing issues to avoid creating a duplicate.
- I have provided enough information to reproduce the problem.
- I have removed passwords, tokens, and other sensitive information.
- This is not a security vulnerability. I will report security issues privately using the process in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
